'''Barma Fel'Lona''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] ringer working for the casino of the [[Sanads of Rorkee]] hotel. A quiet person, Fel'Lona was a hard worker, but she disliked her career for ethical reasons, and harbored some disdain toward her workmate [[Har Fuggaw]] for not sharing those same moral concerns. Fel'Lona would rather have worked as an actress in fantasy settings, but there were no job opportunities in that field for a Rodian in Rorkee. She would nevertheless had accepted a better job as a bribe in exchange for information.
